# INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0 — Professional-Grade Missing-Component Checklists

This package expands the 72 missing components identified by the v4.2.0 audit into executable engineering checklists.

## Checklist structure

- 72 component files, one per `MC-*` item.
- 50 baseline engineering controls per component (**3,600 baseline checks total**).
- Additional component-specific technical controls where the component semantics require them.
- Every baseline check has a stable ID and explicit evidence expectation.
- Each component closes with a production-oriented Definition of Done.

## Status convention

- `[ ]` not complete
- `[x]` complete
- Waived items should remain unchecked and link to the formal waiver/technical-debt ledger.

## Component index


---

> **Execution record (v4.3.0, 2026-09-22):** ticked items are evidenced by package-local code/tests/docs in `inv06_traditional_iac` 4.3.0. Unticked items are open, draft, owner-required, external or blocked as annotated. Definition-of-Done items are never self-certified; they require the independent reviewers named in `governance/OWNERS.yaml`.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-001-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-001-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

- [ ] **MC-003-SC-09** — Pin parser/compiler versions and define accepted language/features/extensions.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-004-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-004-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-009-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-009-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-010 — Durable remote-state backend

**Category:** Durable State, Execution, and Integration  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C032`, `C037`, `C057`, `C095`  

## Component objective

Transactional persistent state with durability guarantees, integrity metadata, revision history, and recovery semantics.

## Required capability focus

- Transactional persistent state with durability guarantees.
- integrity metadata.
- revision history.
- recovery semantics.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** durable.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-010-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-010-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-010-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-010-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.

# MC-013 — State rollback engine

**Category:** Durable State, Execution, and Integration  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C038`, `C092`  

## Component objective

Operator and automated rollback with preconditions, reversible/irreversible operation classification, and rollback evidence.

## Required capability focus

- Operator.
- automated rollback with preconditions.
- reversible/irreversible operation classification.
- rollback evidence.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** durable.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-013-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-05** — Classify operations as reversible, compensatable, recreate-only, or irreversible before execution.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-06** — Require explicit rollback preconditions and verify target revisions have not diverged.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-07** — Capture rollback plan, actor, reason, affected resources, and post-rollback verification evidence.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-08** — Test rollback after partial failure, provider timeout, state restore, and schema migration.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-09** — Generate a machine-readable signed evidence bundle tied to exact source, build, dependency, test, and environment identities.
- [ ] **MC-013-SC-10** — Include pass/fail/skip semantics and prohibit silent omission of required gates.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-015-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-015-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-018-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-018-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

- [ ] All **50** `MC-024-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-024-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

- [ ] **MC-025-SC-08** — Test intermittent links, clock drift, power loss, duplicate replay, and long-offline rejoin.
- [ ] **MC-025-SC-09** — Define immutable base artifact plus mutable overlay schema and deterministic precedence.
- [ ] **MC-025-SC-10** — Reject unknown keys, invalid types, conflicting overlays, and unsupported environment combinations.

# MC-027 — Admission/load-shedding/circuit-breaker controls

**Category:** Durable State, Execution, and Integration  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C054  

## Component objective

Protect state/provider/control-plane dependencies from overload and cascading failure.

## Required capability focus

- Protect state/provider/control-plane dependencies from overload.
- cascading failure.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** resilience.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-027-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-027-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-027-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-027-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-027-SC-05** — Maintain an allowlist with exact provider versions, source origins, digests, signatures, and revocation state.

- [ ] All component-specific `MC-027-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-029 — Failover and residency-aware continuity controller

**Category:** Durable State, Execution, and Integration  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C055  

## Component objective

Failover rules that preserve consistency, isolation, data residency, and ownership.

## Required capability focus

- Failover rules that preserve consistency.
- isolation.
- data residency.
- ownership.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** resilience.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-029-SC-01** — Define authority transfer, state freshness, fencing, and residency constraints before failover.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-02** — Prevent dual-active mutation unless the consistency model explicitly permits it.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-03** — Verify recovery-point and recovery-time objectives under site loss and partition.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-04** — Document failback and post-failover reconciliation with evidence.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-05** — Define unique tenant/workload namespaces across state, execution, network, telemetry, cache, and audit paths.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-06** — Prevent cross-tenant identifiers from becoming authorization bypasses.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-07** — Enforce quotas and noisy-neighbor controls at all shared resource boundaries.
- [ ] **MC-029-SC-08** — Test cross-tenant reads/writes, side channels, cache bleed, log leakage, and resource starvation.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-031-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-031-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-032 — Formal threat model

**Category:** Security, Trust, and Isolation  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C041`, `C050`, `C087`  

## Component objective

Tenant, workload, provider, parser, plan, state, supply-chain, replay, spoofing, exhaustion, escape, and control-plane abuse analysis.

## Required capability focus

- Tenant.
- workload.
- provider.
- parser.
- plan.
- state.
- supply-chain.
- replay.
- spoofing.
- exhaustion.
- escape.
- control-plane abuse analysis.

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-032-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-05** — Maintain an allowlist with exact provider versions, source origins, digests, signatures, and revocation state.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-06** — Isolate provider processes and constrain filesystem, network, environment, and credential access.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-07** — Define provider startup, handshake, timeout, cancellation, retry, crash, and protocol-version behavior.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-08** — Retain conformance fixtures for every supported provider/version combination.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-09** — Create data-flow diagrams and enumerate assets, actors, entry points, trust boundaries, and abuse cases.
- [ ] **MC-032-SC-10** — Model tenant, operator, provider, parser, supply-chain, replay, spoofing, exhaustion, and escape threats.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-034-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-034-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-035 — Ambient-authority sandbox

**Category:** Security, Trust, and Isolation  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C043  

## Component objective

Filesystem, network, device, process, kernel, environment, and secret capability minimization for IaC execution.

## Required capability focus

- Filesystem.
- network.
- device.
- process.
- kernel.
- environment.
- secret capability minimization for IaC execution.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** execution.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-035-SC-01** — Run untrusted IaC/provider execution with explicit filesystem, network, process, device, kernel, and environment capabilities.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-02** — Block ambient credential discovery and require scoped secret injection.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-03** — Constrain CPU, memory, pids, file descriptors, disk, and network to resist exhaustion.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-04** — Test escape attempts, symlink/path traversal, namespace crossing, socket abuse, and child-process spawning.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-05** — Classify secret-bearing fields and apply redaction at source before logs/traces/errors are emitted.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-06** — Prevent secrets from entering plans, fixtures, crash dumps, metrics labels, and high-cardinality diagnostics.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-07** — Use short-lived scoped secret delivery rather than persistent environment-wide credentials.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-08** — Test structured/unstructured redaction bypasses, encoding tricks, nested objects, and provider error echo.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-09** — Define actions/resources/conditions for plan, apply, protect, state, import/export, emergency, and administrative operations.
- [ ] **MC-035-SC-10** — Default deny and enforce least privilege plus separation of duties for high-risk actions.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-037-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-037-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-040-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-040-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-041 — Secret/redaction guard

**Category:** Security, Trust, and Isolation  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C039`, `C075`  

## Component objective

Prevent credentials and sensitive values from plans, state diagnostics, logs, traces, fixtures, and high-cardinality debugging.

## Required capability focus

- Prevent credentials.
- sensitive values from plans.
- state diagnostics.
- logs.
- traces.
- fixtures.
- high-cardinality debugging.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** security.py, observability.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-041-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-05** — Classify secret-bearing fields and apply redaction at source before logs/traces/errors are emitted.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-06** — Prevent secrets from entering plans, fixtures, crash dumps, metrics labels, and high-cardinality diagnostics.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-07** — Use short-lived scoped secret delivery rather than persistent environment-wide credentials.
- [ ] **MC-041-SC-08** — Test structured/unstructured redaction bypasses, encoding tricks, nested objects, and provider error echo.

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-043-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-043-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-043-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

**Category:** Observability, Explainability, and Performance  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0

## Component objective

Prometheus/OpenTelemetry or equivalent export for rate, errors, latency, saturation, backlog, lock contention, provider latency, resource use, and plan/apply outcomes.

- saturation.
- backlog.
- lock contention.
- provider latency.
- resource use.
- plan/apply outcomes.

# MC-045 — Structured logging pipeline

**Category:** Observability, Explainability, and Performance  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C073`, `C075`  

## Component objective

Stable node/tenant/workload/component/operation identifiers, redaction, severity, schema version, and centralized export.

## Required capability focus

- Stable node/tenant/workload/component/operation identifiers.
- redaction.
- severity.
- schema version.
- centralized export.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** observability.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-045-SC-01** — Define unique tenant/workload namespaces across state, execution, network, telemetry, cache, and audit paths.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-02** — Prevent cross-tenant identifiers from becoming authorization bypasses.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-03** — Enforce quotas and noisy-neighbor controls at all shared resource boundaries.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-04** — Test cross-tenant reads/writes, side channels, cache bleed, log leakage, and resource starvation.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-05** — Define a versioned structured log schema with timestamp, severity, component, operation, tenant/workload, and correlation IDs.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-06** — Apply redaction before serialization and central export.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-07** — Guarantee bounded local buffering and explicit drop/backpressure behavior.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-08** — Test schema evolution, multiline/provider errors, log sink outage, and high-volume bursts.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-09** — Classify secret-bearing fields and apply redaction at source before logs/traces/errors are emitted.
- [ ] **MC-045-SC-10** — Prevent secrets from entering plans, fixtures, crash dumps, metrics labels, and high-cardinality diagnostics.

**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C074  

## Component objective

Trace-context propagation through policy, state, provider, inventory, GitOps, and dynamic-infrastructure boundaries.

## Required capability focus

- Trace-context propagation through policy.
- state.
- provider.
- inventory.
- GitOps.
- dynamic-infrastructure boundaries.

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________

- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** observability.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-046-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-05** — Maintain an allowlist with exact provider versions, source origins, digests, signatures, and revocation state.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-06** — Isolate provider processes and constrain filesystem, network, environment, and credential access.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-07** — Define provider startup, handshake, timeout, cancellation, retry, crash, and protocol-version behavior.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-08** — Retain conformance fixtures for every supported provider/version combination.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-09** — Bind each decision to exact policy bundle/version/digest and evaluation inputs.
- [ ] **MC-046-SC-10** — Fail closed for mandatory controls when policy evaluation is unavailable or indeterminate.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-046-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-046-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-048 — Release-lineage/live-graph correlation

**Category:** Observability, Explainability, and Performance  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C078  

## Component objective

Correlate IaC events with application release IDs, artifact versions, state revisions, and current infrastructure graph.

## Required capability focus

- Correlate IaC events with application release IDs.
- artifact versions.
- state revisions.
- current infrastructure graph.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________

- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** observability.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-048-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-05** — Define node/edge types, dependency inference, explicit dependency overrides, and graph normalization.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-06** — Detect cycles with actionable diagnostics and prohibit nondeterministic cycle breaking.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-07** — Specify create/update/replace/destroy ordering and parallelism constraints.
- [ ] **MC-048-SC-08** — Verify graph output is stable for equivalent inputs and survives large/deep dependency graphs.

# MC-053 — Tenant/workload overhead and capacity model

**Category:** Observability, Explainability, and Performance  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** `C064`, `C067`, `C069`  

## Component objective

Per-tenant cost, saturation indicators, scale triggers, queue/fan-out bounds, and state growth forecasts.

## Required capability focus

- Per-tenant cost.
- saturation indicators.
- scale triggers.
- queue/fan-out bounds.
- state growth forecasts.

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-053-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-05** — Define unique tenant/workload namespaces across state, execution, network, telemetry, cache, and audit paths.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-06** — Prevent cross-tenant identifiers from becoming authorization bypasses.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-07** — Enforce quotas and noisy-neighbor controls at all shared resource boundaries.
- [ ] **MC-053-SC-08** — Test cross-tenant reads/writes, side channels, cache bleed, log leakage, and resource starvation.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-055-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-055-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-056 — Public-interface contract test suite

**Category:** Testing, Certification, Release, and Operations  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C082  

## Component objective

Tests for every plan/state/drift/provider/policy/identity boundary and schema-version behavior.

## Required capability focus

- Tests for every plan/state/drift/provider/policy/identity boundary.
- schema-version behavior.

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________

- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** tests/test_production.py, tests/test_component.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-056-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-05** — Maintain an allowlist with exact provider versions, source origins, digests, signatures, and revocation state.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-06** — Isolate provider processes and constrain filesystem, network, environment, and credential access.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-07** — Define provider startup, handshake, timeout, cancellation, retry, crash, and protocol-version behavior.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-08** — Retain conformance fixtures for every supported provider/version combination.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-09** — Bind each decision to exact policy bundle/version/digest and evaluation inputs.
- [ ] **MC-056-SC-10** — Fail closed for mandatory controls when policy evaluation is unavailable or indeterminate.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-058-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-058-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-059 — Fuzz/property-based test suite

**Category:** Testing, Certification, Release, and Operations  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C085  

## Component objective

State/plan schemas, parsers, provider responses, corrupt snapshots, boundary values, and hostile untrusted inputs.

## Required capability focus

- State/plan schemas.
- parsers.
- provider responses.
- corrupt snapshots.
- boundary values.
- hostile untrusted inputs.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** tests/test_production.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-059-SC-01** — Define the canonical state schema, revision identifier, integrity digest, and monotonic update rules.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-02** — Specify compare-and-swap or transactional semantics so stale state writers cannot commit.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-03** — Verify state corruption is detected before mutation and produces a non-destructive recovery path.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-04** — Define maximum supported state size and state-compaction or archival behavior.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-05** — Maintain an allowlist with exact provider versions, source origins, digests, signatures, and revocation state.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-06** — Isolate provider processes and constrain filesystem, network, environment, and credential access.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-07** — Define provider startup, handshake, timeout, cancellation, retry, crash, and protocol-version behavior.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-08** — Retain conformance fixtures for every supported provider/version combination.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-09** — Generate valid, boundary, malformed, recursive, oversized, truncated, and adversarial inputs.
- [ ] **MC-059-SC-10** — Run deterministic seeded fuzzing plus property-based invariants for state and plan operations.

- [ ] **MC-060-SC-01** — Define lease acquisition, renewal, expiry, fencing-token issuance, and stale-holder rejection semantics.

- [ ] **MC-060-SC-08** — Retain conformance fixtures for every supported provider/version combination.
- [ ] **MC-060-SC-09** — Inject process crashes, node loss, site loss, provider errors, lock loss, stale leases, partitions, and clock anomalies.
- [ ] **MC-060-SC-10** — Define expected safety invariants for every fault point before running the test.

- [ ] **MC-061-SC-10** — Exercise burst overload and high-concurrency fleet behavior in addition to steady state.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-062-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-062-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-063 — Canary/staged rollout automation

**Category:** Testing, Certification, Release, and Operations  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C092  

## Component objective

Progressive exposure, health gates, halt criteria, rollback triggers, and emergency disable.

## Required capability focus

- Progressive exposure.
- health gates.
- halt criteria.
- rollback triggers.
- emergency disable.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** release.py
- **Status:** implemented (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-063-SC-01** — Classify operations as reversible, compensatable, recreate-only, or irreversible before execution.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-02** — Require explicit rollback preconditions and verify target revisions have not diverged.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-03** — Capture rollback plan, actor, reason, affected resources, and post-rollback verification evidence.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-04** — Test rollback after partial failure, provider timeout, state restore, and schema migration.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-05** — Define rollout stages, cohort selection, minimum observation windows, and promotion criteria.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-06** — Automate health/SLO/policy gates between stages and stop promotion on violation.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-07** — Define rollback triggers and emergency-disable behavior independent of the primary deployment path.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-08** — Test canary halt and rollback under partial infrastructure and telemetry failure.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-09** — Define liveness, readiness, progress, and stall signals separately.
- [ ] **MC-063-SC-10** — Detect stuck operations using bounded progress deadlines rather than process existence alone.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-065-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-065-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.

# MC-066 — Incident response runbook

**Category:** Testing, Certification, Release, and Operations  
**Baseline:** INV-06 Traditional IaC v4.2.0  
**Source references:** C097  

## Component objective

Severity model, paging, escalation, containment, evidence preservation, recovery, communication, and post-incident review.

## Required capability focus

- Severity model.
- paging.
- escalation.
- containment.
- evidence preservation.
- recovery.
- communication.
- post-incident review.

## Implementation record

- **Accountable owner:** ____________________
- **Technical lead:** ____________________
- **Security reviewer:** ____________________
- **Operations reviewer:** ____________________
- **Target release:** ____________________
- **Risk classification:** ____________________
- **Dependencies:** ____________________
- **Evidence location:** ops/RUNBOOK.md
- **Status:** draft (v4.3.0 execution pass, 2026-09-22)

## Component-specific technical controls

- [ ] **MC-066-SC-01** — Generate a machine-readable signed evidence bundle tied to exact source, build, dependency, test, and environment identities.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-02** — Include pass/fail/skip semantics and prohibit silent omission of required gates.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-03** — Verify evidence signatures and schema before release promotion.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-04** — Retain immutable evidence according to audit and release policy.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-05** — Define incident severity, paging thresholds, commander role, technical leads, communications, and escalation paths.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-06** — Provide containment actions for freeze/quarantine, credentials, keys, providers, and compromised artifacts.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-07** — Preserve forensic evidence with chain of custody and time synchronization.
- [ ] **MC-066-SC-08** — Require recovery validation and blameless post-incident corrective-action tracking.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All **50** `MC-070-CHK-*` controls are complete or have an approved, non-expired waiver.
- [ ] All component-specific `MC-070-SC-*` controls, when present, are complete.
- [ ] No unresolved critical/high security defect remains without formal risk acceptance.
- [ ] Required tests are automated in CI and are release-blocking at the appropriate gate.
- [ ] Operational recovery/rollback procedure has been exercised, not merely documented.
- [ ] Observability proves normal, degraded, failed, and recovering states can be distinguished.
- [ ] Compatibility/support declarations match actual validated test evidence.
- [ ] Traceability links requirements → design → implementation → tests → evidence → release decision.
- [ ] Independent technical, security, and operations reviewers have signed off.
- [ ] Production gate records the exact artifact/version promoted.
